topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
response: Orbital configurations that justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication are not explicitly stated in the Context.
